generation_arguments_pinned.note: FLUX.1-dev diffusers defaults, pinned explicitly rather than relied on. CPU generators are used so initial latents are identical across arms and independent of which GPU runs the job.
generation_arguments_pinned.output_format: PNG (lossless; filenames stay parseable by eval/llava.py)

seeds.rule: first four / first one of the release default list [188,288,588,688,888]

retained_rule.related_rule: same biological class as target (Mammalia), class_available order, excluding Human and excluding the other two sprint objects
retained_rule.unrelated_rule: first two class_available entries that are neither animal nor natural phenomenon (Flame/Sea/Waterfalls excluded as phenomena)
retained_rule.dedup_note: RELATED and UNRELATED panels are identical for all three objects, so M0 and T0 retained generations are produced once and reused; edited arms (N/control/prototype) are per-object and never reused.
